root_cause: The site had strong technical SEO primitives and localized routes, but English pages inherited translated Dutch search positioning, the sitemap did not explicitly enumerate final English canonicals, absolute same-origin links could leak users back to Dutch, and the AI Modelwijzer/data-sovereignty opportunities were not fully integrated into canonical keyword ownership and revenue internal linking.
prevention: Keep one canonical keyword/search-intent owner per locale.
Select English keywords from English market evidence and SERP intent, not literal Dutch translation.
Generate final NL/EN self-canonical routes with nl/en/x-default hreflang and include English canonicals in the final sitemap.
Rewrite same-origin absolute links to the active locale.
Require every commercial/revenue-priority owner to have a measurable conversion destination and contextual inbound links.
Run SEO apply and validate in the production build before static locale generation.
Measure organic outcomes through CTA, lead, proposal, paid order and realized revenue.
fix: Add site/seo-locale-revenue-map.json, market-specific EN titles/H1/descriptions, locale-preserving link rewrite, EN sitemap/hreflang output, production SEO apply/validate, Modelwijzer and data-sovereignty intent ownership, bidirectional AI internal linking, CI regression coverage, skills/agents/system-map writeback.
